bass_pc.description: Slash chord; null if root position.

omissions.description: Degrees deliberately dropped by the difficulty engine.

line.description: Staff line the clef sits on.

octave_change.description: Octave transposition drawn with the clef (guitar treble = -1).

code.description: An E_* or W_* code from the registry in Appendix 5.4.

merged_count.description: How many source notes collapsed into this one.

quantize_shift_ticks.description: Signed magnitude of the applied snap.

tab_relaxed.description: The guitar fret window had to be widened to place this note.

guitar_allow_open_strings.description: Section 2.0 lists this parameter; true at every level, preferred at Simple.

note_budget_nps.description: Notes per second, per part; null means unrestricted.

show_dynamics.description: Whether dynamics are notated at all. The vocabulary is a function of `level`: Medium emits p/mf/f only, Complex adds the full range plus hairpins (Section 2.0), so no separate granularity field is needed.

transcription_frame_ms.description: Transcription time resolution; 11.61 ms for basic-pitch.

index.description: 0-based; a pickup measure is index 0 with implicit = true.

duration_rational.description: Non-null only for tuplet durations that are not integral in ticks.

is_chord_member.description: MusicXML <chord/>: shares an onset with the previous note.

octave.description: Scientific pitch notation; middle C = C4.

origin_ids.description: RawNote ids (INV-3); empty only for engine-inserted material.

render.description: false => retained for provenance but not drawn.

OrnamentPolicy.description: How ornaments (trills, mordents, grace notes) are treated. Section 2.0's profile table lists this parameter; Section 3.5's interface omitted it, so it is added here — dropping it would lose normative information.

chords.description: Usually populated only on the primary harmonic part.

alpha.description: Fidelity: timing error in grid units.

gamma.description: Tuplet penalty. The architecture states Infinity at Simple; because JSON cannot carry Infinity, Simple uses a large finite value and the authoritative gate on tuplets is the empty allow_tuplets list.

RawNote.description: A note event straight out of S3/S4, before any symbolic decision is taken.

fingerprint.description: BLAKE3 over the audio hash and every stage fingerprint.

Seconds.description: Audio-domain time, absolute from the start of the decoded, untrimmed audio.

position.description: Hand position — the fret under the index finger.

TimingGrid.description: The timing grid: the only legal bridge between seconds and ticks (INV-5).

anacrusis_ticks.description: Length of the pickup; 0 if none.

tempo_map.description: >= 1 entry, sorted by tick, first tick == 0.

time_signatures.description: >= 1 entry, sorted by tick, first tick == 0.

strings.description: MIDI pitch of each open string; index 0 = string 1 (highest).

actual.description: Notes actually played in the span.

level.description: Nesting depth; one level of nesting is the maximum (Section 2.2.3).

normal.description: Notes the span would normally hold.

frame.description: Per-string fret; index 0 = string 1 (highest). null = not played, -1 = muted.

left_hand.description: Piano only: pitches assigned to the left hand.

right_hand.description: Piano only: pitches assigned to the right hand.

score.description: From the scoring function in Section 2.2.2.

description: The only inter-stage contract in AudioSheet (INV-4). Generated from packages/schema/src/*.ts; do not hand-edit.
title: ScoreDocument
